text:
morgan: Heads-up — nightly apples-to-apples job flagged a regression in the kernel-selector benchmark for short-sequence traffic. p50 latency up ~11% (vs golden run), 99th roughly +6%. KV cache hit rate dropped ~8% on the same replay. Attached artifacts in CI.
perfbot: nightly-bench · regression alert
- test: kernel-selector-shortseq
- metric: p50 latency
- delta: +11.2% (threshold 5%)
- run_id: 2026-03-18-18742
- artifacts: https://ci.internal/reports/2026-03-18/18742
sam: @morgan can you paste the exact repro command? i'll spin up a local replay.
morgan: sure — run the apples harness with the kernel-selector profile and golden comparator:
```
make bench-replay PROFILE=kernel-selector SEED=20260318 COMPARE=golden --out=artifacts/18742
```
Also include `KV_WARMUP=1` env to get warmup curves.
jin: i saw a batching heuristics tweak in PR #6321 that landed yesterday — it lowered the max batch delay for short sequences. cc: could be causing different kernel code-paths to be selected more often.
elyse: did the CUDA/toolkit upgrade land on the runners? i saw a driver bump in infra yesterday which can change kernel timings.
benchbot: CI job https://ci.internal/job/bench/18742 finished. Flamegraphs and perf profiles uploaded: https://ci.internal/artifacts/18742/profiles.tar.gz
sam: i'm starting a rerun now with three variants: (1) golden config, (2) post-PR config, (3) pin old batching delay. will collect KV hit rate and kernel selection traces. ETA ~30m.
morgan: thanks. when you upload, add the kernel-selection csv (`/artifacts/kernel_choices.csv`) — that'll make apples-to-apples comparison easier.
jin: if this reproduces, we should check the selector threshold table. I have a quick script that diffs chosen kernels by step. snippet:
```
python tools/diff_kernels.py --before artifacts/golden/kernel_choices.csv --after artifacts/18742/kernel_choices.csv
```
It prints per-layer divergences and counts.
sam: ran variant (3) with old delay pinned — interestingly p50 is back to within 1% of golden and KV hit rate recovers. so heuristics change seems likely root cause.
elyse: OK — interim action: revert the batching delay tweak on canary until we validate. Also add a CI blocker to prevent merges that change selector heuristics without new apples perf sign-off.
morgan: agreed. next steps:
- sam to open a triage ticket with reproducer and artifacts (assign: sam)
- jin to draft revert PR for the batching tweak (assign: jin)
- perfbot/ci to add a stricter alert if kernel-choice divergence > 3% across layers
- infra to confirm runner driver image is stable (elyse)
sam: creating ticket: https://tracker.internal/REDWOOD-4312 with logs + rerun link. I'll also add the `diff_kernels` output.
jin: i'll prep the revert PR and include a test that runs the apples harness in a smoke mode in CI to catch this earlier.
morgan: thanks all. once the revert is in we should re-run the nightly apples job and mark the alert as resolved. :thumbsup:
perfbot: alert status: acknowledged by morgan. follow-ups tracked in REDWOOD-4312.
